name: Demon Ship
source: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-00: Salt of the Ocean
description: A demonic presence animates the ship carrying demon pirates.
disable: DC 20 Religion (trained) to ward against demonic presence, DC 20 Arcana (trained) or DC 20 Occultism (trained) to weaken the demonic possession, DC 20 Intimidation (trained) to scare it away, or sailing-lore|dc:18 (trained) to confuse it; two total successes are required to disable the hazard.
routine:
◆◆ The demon ship uses its actions on one of the following options (GM's choice). It loses one action from its routine if a PC succeeds at an attempt to Disable it or it reaches its Broken Threshold.

  • Broadside Blast a The demon ship makes a Chthonian cannon Strike.
  • Demonic List d Effect The ship tosses and turns. Each creature in the hazard's area must make a DC 20 Reflex Saving Throw save. On a failure, it is knocked Prone; on a critical failure it also takes 2d10 Bludgeoning Damage damage.
  • Heads Will Roll a It makes a bowsprit Strike.
  • Sea Chantey a (auditory) All fiends within 60 feet gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls, damage rolls, and saves against fear effects; all non-fiends within 60 feet must succeed at a DC 20 Will Saving Throw save or become Frightened 1 (Frightened 2 on a critical failure).

Effect: Sea Chantey

defensiveAbilities.name: No Prey, No Pay
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger The demon ship hits another ship and Encounter A begins

Effect The demon ship fires grapples at the Snapdragon. Each PC must attempt a DC 20 Reflex Saving Throw save or be Grabbed (Escape dc=20); on a critical failure, they're also impaled and take (1d10+6) Piercing Damage damage. The demon ship then rolls initiative.
